title: P-ERASE probe set and P-PRES seed set for the preregistration (PREREG_DRAFT OPEN 2)
objective: Specify the P-ERASE paired carry-over probe set (probe episodes, the two preceding-episode conditions, the exact differing-action count and how many probes), and the P-PRES fixed seed set, as text for PREREG_DRAFT s5 plus adapter functions with plumbing tests on random or hand-wired organisms.
parent_objective: native witness preparation (opens as its own campaign only if C-009 closes)
problem: Plumbing: show on a hand-wired leaky construction that the probe can register a difference and on a non-leaky one that it registers 0 -- using constructions, not the subject or the registered arms' outputs. No accuracy statistic.
non_goals: No subject evolution; no witness predicate on Ares output; no accuracy/retention/reward number for any arm or control
No change to rso/binding or the slice evidence plane (BX6)
evidence_required: RED first for the new functions

acceptance.condition: all evidence_required items; no outcome observed

authority: operator directive 2026-10-07 (C-004-OP8) s6, s11 (preparation allowed; no outcomes before preregistration)
